import ast,collections,json,pathlib,sys,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(p))
from audit_capsule import pe_metadata,pdb_metadata
for name in ("audit_capsule.py","Collect-Facts.py","Seal-Facts.py"):
    ast.parse((p/name).read_text())
report={}
for role in ("baseline","default"):
    directory=p/role/"artifacts"/"bin"/"Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.Tests"/"Debug"/"net12.0"
    mvid,cv=pe_metadata(directory/"Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.dll")
    ident,docs=pdb_metadata(directory/"Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi.pdb")
    assert any((e["guid"],e["stamp"])==ident for e in cv)
    rows=json.loads((p/"results"/f"{role}-producer"/"assertions.json").read_text())
    assert len(rows)==29 and all(row["pass"] for row in rows)
    assert sum(row["name"]=="isolated-public-metadata-multiple-control" for row in rows)==1
    xml=ET.parse(p/"results"/f"{role}-existing"/f"{role}.trx")
    outcomes=dict(collections.Counter(row.attrib["outcome"] for row in xml.getroot().iter("{http://microsoft.com/schemas/VisualStudio/TeamTest/2010}UnitTestResult")))
    assert outcomes=={"Passed":105,"NotExecuted":2}
    report[role]={"mvid":mvid,"portablePdbDocuments":len(docs),"characterizationAssertions":len(rows),"isolatedGuardControls":1,"existingRows":outcomes}
source=json.loads((p/"handoff"/"source-catalog.json").read_text())
assert len(source)==66 and all(row["normalizedWorkingBytesMatchGitBlob"] for row in source)
print(json.dumps({"pass":True,"roleChecks":report,"selectedGitLfRows":len(source),"artifactPythonSyntax":"passed"},indent=2))
